new_background_method: One calibrated continuous empty background image per shot, projected with the same camera used for the character. No original/generated background patchwork or per-frame architecture deformation.
character_registration: Source face position in scene coordinates and stable apparent head size; generated-frame crop/scale changes canceled before composition.
matting: Robust Video Matting MobileNetV3 with recurrent temporal state; foreground color and alpha.
interpolation: Foreground RGBA only, camera/background projected independently at the same sub-frame time.
limitations: Only six newly generated native frames were produced before the next image generation was blocked. Other character poses are reused or interpolated; acting remains approximate. The reconstructed background matches the reference scene approximately.
